purpose: Teach: デュアル/ダイアログ/コンパイル/アンカー/グリッド/シールド/レビューア/コストパフォーマンス
target_vocab: コストパフォーマンス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、製品をデュアル展開、つまり二系統で売れ
lines.en: Our company will sell the product through a dual distribution model—two separate channels.
lines.style: Measured, direct opening. Crisp articulation on 'dual.' Authoritative but not rushed. Pausing slightly before the clarification to ensure comprehension. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内ダイアログボックスのUIを改善します
lines.en: Understood. We'll improve the internal dialog box UI.
lines.style: Clear, professional acknowledgment. Quick uptake—he's already mentally moving to the action items. Clipped, efficient tone. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、開発のコンパイル時間を短縮しろ
lines.en: Our company needs to reduce development compile time.
lines.style: Direct command. Weight on the verb 'reduce.' No softening—this is an expectation. Steady, controlled delivery. The tone of someone used to being followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告動画のアンカー、つまり司会者を選定します
lines.en: Understood. We'll select the anchor—the host—for the promotional video.
lines.style: Rapid response, practical. Brief pause before clarification on 'anchor.' Professional, moving forward. Confirms receipt without elaboration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品棚のグリッド配置を見直せ
lines.en: Our company needs to reconsider the product shelf grid layout.
lines.style: Clear directive tone. Slight emphasis on 'reconsider'—this is a revision, not a new build. Composed, expectant. The authority of someone stating necessary change.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品のシールド塗装を試験します
lines.en: Understood. We'll trial the shield coating for the new product.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Light forward momentum—he's already onto the next task. Professional, no drag. Clipped, ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社外レビューア、つまり評価者の意見を採り入れろ
lines.en: Our company needs to incorporate feedback from external reviewers—the evaluation specialists.
lines.style: Direct mandate. Clarifying pause before 'evaluation specialists.' Measured delivery—this is strategic input, not optional. Composed authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品のコストパフォーマンスを訴求します
lines.en: Understood. We'll highlight the product's cost-to-performance value proposition.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly warmer closure. Quick, decisive. The release point of the meeting. Professional but the smallest hint of resolution in the pace.
